questions.q: What happened to the 10-year Treasury yield, and how did it affect stocks?

questions.q: What effect did the High Court appeal bid have on AGL Energy according to market participants?
o: It redefined the medium-term investment narrative and modified the risk parameters for equity stakeholders.
It forced the company to enter a state-backed diesel subsidy framework managed by fiscal authorities.
It triggered an automatic currency intervention by the central bank to defend the NAFEM spot rate.
It eliminated all net tangible asset valuations underpinning the quarterly retail REIT distribution.
questions.e: The High Court appeal bid confronted AGL Energy, redefining its medium-term investment narrative and modifying risk parameters as market participants repriced the equity for potential judicial outcomes. The other choices incorrectly tie the legal challenge to Brazilian diesel subsidies, Nigerian foreign exchange, or REIT net asset metrics.
